title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

Job Location: Ferndown, Dorset

Job Type: Permanent

Salary: Up to £32,000 per annum, depending on experience

Hours: 37.5 hours per week, Monday - Thursday 8.30am - 5pm & Friday 8.30am - 15.45pm

We are looking to recruit for a HR Administrator for a manufacturing company based in Ferndown.

The company employ 90 staff, who are friendly & supportive.

In this role, you will be the on-site face of HR, handling day-to-day employee queries and paperwork.

You will be supported by a HR Consultant.

Key responsibilities:
- Being the first point of contact for employee questions about holidays, sick leave, and company policies.
- Managing recruitment for the business including arranging offer letters and contracts
- Setting up of new starters including inductions, check right-to-work documents, tracking probation deadlines, and handling leaver paperwork
- Keeping up to date records for employees
- Collating timesheets for payroll processing
- Undertaking company administration including business insurance, managing company cars, office supplies, booking accommodation / travel for engineers etc

We are looking for;
- Experience of working within HR Administration
- Excellent communication skills
- Strong attention to detail
- PC literate with experience of Excel/Word/Outlook

For more information on this position, please send through your CV.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Are you an experienced Bookkeeper looking for a role where your expertise is valued, your development is supported, and you can enjoy genuine flexibility?

A well-established and highly regarded accountancy practice in Bournemouth, Dorset is looking to welcome a Bookkeeper to its growing team. This is an excellent opportunity to join a friendly and collaborative environment where you'll work closely with a wide range of clients, build strong relationships, and play a key role in helping businesses stay financially organised and compliant.

Offering hybrid working, ongoing professional development, and clear opportunities for progression, this role would suit an experienced bookkeeping professional who enjoys taking ownership of their work whilst being part of a supportive team.

What will the Bookkeeper role involve?
- Managing bookkeeping for a varied portfolio of clients, ensuring records are accurate, up to date and compliant
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns and CIS returns across a range of industries
- Reviewing client bookkeeping records and making necessary adjustments ahead of submission deadlines
- Supporting clients with cloud-based accounting software, primarily QuickBooks and Xero
- Providing guidance and practical support to help clients get the most from their bookkeeping processes
- Contributing to a high-quality client experience through proactive communication and attention to detail

Suitable Candidate for the Bookkeeper vacancy:
- Previous bookkeeping experience within an accountancy practice or bookkeeping environment
- Strong working knowledge of VAT, CIS, QuickBooks and Xero
- Confident working independently and managing multiple priorities effectively
- Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work
- Organised, proactive and client-focused approach
- Strong communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships

Additional benefits and information for the role of Bookkeeper:
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Supportive and collaborative team culture
- Modern working environment with a strong focus on employee wellbeing
- Salary will be dependent on experience

title: Finance Assistant
description:
REED Accountancy and Finance are actively recruiting a temp Finance Assistant to start ASAP (After DBS Check has been completed) for a 7 - 8 month contract (potential to go perm) for an Not for profit education establishment based near Sherborne. You will need to be Immediately available to start and undergo REED Screening compliance checks (including full referencing and DBS Enhanced Check) before commencement of the assignment. Joining a Finance Team, you will report into the Assistant Finance Director to support in a varied role. HYBRID Options are available

Finance Assistant (Part Qualified AAT / Significant QBE in Finance)

Office Based (Sherborne) initially - with HYBRID Options Available

Hours - 30 hours / Full Time

Trips

Other Duties
- Support the AFD and wider Income and Billing Team as needed in areas such as invoicing for subsidiary companies and other general requirements as can be reasonably required.

title: Purchasing Assistant
description:
Purchasing Assistant - Poole - Up to £30,000

With real scope to build your procurement expertise, you'll be trusted with the accuracy that keeps supply moving, from purchase order to delivery.
Every order, every supplier relationship, every record: it all runs through you.

As a Purchasing Assistant, you will benefit from:
- Structured onboarding and ongoing training in procurement systems and processes
- Support to work towards a recognised procurement qualification such as CIPS
- A stable, well-organised working environment with clear processes to follow
- Exposure to a broad commodity area, building genuine specialist knowledge over time

As a Purchasing Assistant, your responsibilities will include:
- Schedule incoming materials against forecast demand to maintain continuity of supply
- Generate and issue purchase orders to nominated suppliers within your commodity area
- Manage supplier non-conformances alongside Quality and Technical teams, negotiating costs where required
- Expedite outstanding orders and flag supplier delays that could affect production
- Maintain accurate procurement and supply records within the ERP/MRP system
- Investigate supplier price discrepancies and obtain credit notes where necessary

As a Purchasing Assistant, your experience will include:
- Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel, including formula creation and checking
- Working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems, ideally including Oracle
- Experience liaising with suppliers and building effective working relationships
- Strong office administration and organisational skills
- An interest in building a career in procurement within a manufacturing environment
- Willingness to work towards a qualification such as CIPS

If you're looking for a role where your accuracy and reliability are genuinely valued, this Purchasing Assistant position offers a clear path to build real procurement expertise. Apply today with an up-to-date CV or call Nina Cranidge at Rubicon for more information.

While Rubicon uses AI to help speed up processes across the business, every application is reviewed by a human to ensure the right decision is made.

title: HR Coordinator
description:
HR Coordinator - Permanent

Hybrid Christchurch Base

Bi-weekly travel to our regional offices in Sheffield and Widnes

Dovetail Recruitment are proud to be working with a long-standing client who are looking for a HR Coordinator to join their People & Culture team of 7. Having partnered with this business for over 10 years, we have seen first-hand their continued growth and commitment to creating a positive and supportive workplace culture.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced HR professional to join a people-focused organisation where you will play a key role in supporting managers and employees across the full employee lifecycle. Working within a collaborative team, you will gain exposure to a broad range of HR activities including employee relations, recruitment, onboarding, learning and development, performance management, compliance and HR projects.

What's in it for you?
- Competitive salary with annual salary reviews
- Yearly bonus structure (based on company targets)
- 25 days holiday per annum, increasing to 27 days after 3 years' service and 30 days after 5 years' service
- Ability to buy additional holiday
- Medical cash plan, and access to mental health support
- Flexible hours and work from home available to all staff
- Great learning and development and progression opportunities
- Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave
- Generous Company Sick Pay
- Pension Scheme Contribution
- Annual social events
- Cycle to Work scheme

Key Responsibilities

Employee Relations & Performance Management
- Manage employee relations matters, including disciplinary, grievance and absence cases, with support from the People Team.
- Provide day-to-day guidance to managers on performance management and support performance improvement plans.
- Conduct workplace investigations and help resolve employee issues in line with company policies and employment legislation.

Talent Acquisition & Development
- Support recruitment activities, including candidate interviews and cultural fit assessments.
- Coordinate training and development initiatives, including booking sessions and maintaining training records.
- Identify learning and development opportunities to support employee growth.

HR Compliance & Policy
- Ensure compliance with employment legislation and HR best practice.
- Support the review and development of HR policies and procedures.
- Provide guidance on HR-related matters, escalating complex issues where appropriate.

HR Systems, Payroll & Benefits
- Maintain HR systems (including CezanneHR), ensuring accurate employee data and reporting.
- Support payroll administration, pension reporting and employee benefits processes.
- Maintain records relating to leave, pensions and other employee entitlements.

Employee Lifecycle & Culture
- Support the employee journey from recruitment and onboarding through to probation and development.
- Partner with managers to understand workforce needs and skills requirements.
- Help deliver employee engagement, training and wellbeing initiatives, including company social events.
- Provide general HR administration and project support across the People & Culture function.

Requirements
- Previous experience as an HR Coordinator, HR Advisor, People Advisor, HR Officer or HR Generalist.
- Good understanding of employment law and HR best practice.
- CIPD qualification or working towards CIPD would be advantageous.

If you are looking for a varied HR role within a growing business that genuinely values its people, we would love to hear from you. Apply today or contact Laura for more information. Having worked closely with this business for over 10 years, Laura can provide valuable insight into the company, culture and recruitment process to support your application.

title: Receptionist
company: Dorset HealthCare University NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Dorset HealthCare University NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are looking to appoint a reliable and motivated receptionist to join our dedicated administration team to support the Community Mental Health Teams at Kings Park Community Hospital. The successful applicant will work as part of a small team, supporting clinical staff and will act as the first point of contact between patients, relatives and medical staff, whilst maintaining confidentiality to ensure the department always runs efficiently. This is a part-time post of 26 hours per week over Monday, Tuesday (1/2 day), Thursday, Friday. The post holder will be required to work flexibly to meet the needs of the service. Applicants must have excellent organizational and communication skills, be able to work under pressure yet remain calm, polite and professional at all times. You will have the ability to deal with varied administrative duties, IT systems and changing priorities. Excellent customer service skills are essential. You will be pleasant and approachable and able to manage your workload effectively. Employment in this post requires an Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check, which the Trust will cover the cost of. You will provide information to patients, staff, carers, relatives, GPs and the wider Emotional Health and Wellbeing Service relating to appointments, patient care, service pathways and meetings, verbally by telephone, face to face or written in a tactful and courteous manner often requiring non-clinical advice involving careful analysis of delicate situations regarding patient care, requiring knowledge of patient confidentiality. You will liaise with members of the public in their dealings with the team/service, some of whom may prove at times to be distressed, challenging, or aggressive in manner. You will liaise with other members of the service to organise and deliver a safe and efficient office system to support sound patient care, consistent with good clinical governance guidelines, whilst helping the team to achieve targets and complete timely returns of information. You will support clinicians with their work including typing clinical letters and organising appointments. Applications from candidates that require current Skilled worker sponsorship to work in the UK are unfortunately ineligible to apply for this position. For the main duties and responsibilities for this role please read the attached job description and person specification. When completing your application please ensure your supporting statement reflects the criteria set out in these documents by showing how your experience and skills apply to this post. We understand that AI can be a useful tool when completing your application. However, we are seeing an increasing over-reliance of AI tools, which can negatively affect your application as it reduces a candidates individuality, and makes it difficult for us to gain a clear and authentic understanding of your experience, skills, and in turn your suitability for the role. All submissions must be truthful and if you do use AI, it should only be used to enhance your application and not create your supporting statement in its entirety. Your supporting statement should be in your own words and must accurately reflect your personal experience and achievements. Where we have concerns that AI has been used to generate content that misrepresents your experience and suitability for the role, we may withdraw your application. As part of our vision to have a skilled, diverse and caring workforce, Dorset HealthCare offers support for people getting into work. We offer an employability service to support individuals with application writing, interview skills and other employment support. If you would like or know of anyone who would value this support, please do contact dhc.wideningparticipation@nhs.net.

title: Recruitment Administrator
company: University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust
description: If you're looking for an exciting new career opportunity and have experience in Recruitment, Human Resources, or a busy administrative role that requires excellent organisational skills and attention to detail, we'd love to hear from you! The Recruitment Team at University Hospitals Dorset is based in modern offices at Yeoman's House, with the flexibility to work from home for part of the week following your initial training period. As part of this fast-paced and supportive team, you will work closely with recruiting managers across our hospital sites, guiding them through the recruitment process and maintaining regular contact with candidates. We pride ourselves on working collaboratively, supporting one another to deliver an outstanding service to both managers and applicants. Whatever your background, you will share our values and be committed to providing a professional, efficient, and customer-focused recruitment service. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are essential, enabling you to support managers with best practice recruitment processes and ensure candidates progress smoothly through recruitment and onboarding. Base Location: Yeoman's House (behind Castlepoint Shopping Centre), with occasional travel to Bournemouth and Poole Hospitals. Interview Date: Thursday 22nd October Home Working: Following a three-month training period, we offer partial home working, with the option to work from home for up to 40% of your contracted hours per week. Main duties of the job include: Work at pace to support recruiting managers and candidates throughout the recruitment journey, contributing to the Trust's 30-day time-to-hire target. Support candidates to understand pre-employment check requirements in line with NHS Employment Check Standards. Advise managers on recruitment policies, procedures and best practice. Prepare and issue conditional offer letters and employment contracts. Complete all pre-employment checks accurately and efficiently. Contribute to reducing vacancy levels and maintaining safe staffing across the Trust. Attend recruitment events on occasion to promote the Trust and support candidate attraction. Respond to telephone and email enquiries from managers and candidates in a timely and professional manner. To understand the role in more detail please read the full job description and person specification documents which are attached to this advert
